name: Rammus
title: The Armordillo

passive.name: Rolling Armordillo

description.normalized: While out of combat gain, 32 Movement Speed, increased to 60 + Level x 1 during Powerball. Exit combat after not taking damage or using abilities for 5 seconds.

passive.rawParsedText:

Exit combat after not taking damage or using abilities for 5 seconds.

q.name: Powerball

description.normalized: Accelerates up to 115% + level x 5% bonus Movement Speed over 6 seconds. Colliding with an enemy deals 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 (+100% AP) magic damage in an area, knocking back and slowing enemies by 40% / 50% / 60% / 70% for 1 second. Activating cancels Defensive Ball Curl and puts it on cooldown.

e.name: Frenzying Taunt

description.normalized: Taunts an enemy champion or monster for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds and gain 35% / 45% / 55% / 65% Attack Speed decaying over 5 seconds.

r.name: Soaring Slam

description.normalized: Hop into the air and slam down, dealing 75 / 150 / 225 (+50% / 60% / 70% AP) magic damage and creating aftershocks for 4 seconds. Aftershocks deal 30 (+20% AP) magic damage every second and slow enemies incrementally by 10%, stacking up to 50%. If used during Powerball, Powerball's effects are applied at the center of the landing zone. Soaring Slam's range increases with Movement Speed. Soaring Slam damages structures.
